_comment: Standing test fixture for messenger/group tests on staging. Read-only specs use these IDs; never add real members. The group and the test account are the only ones any messenger test may write to, and only through a Vitest test or a deliberate owner-approved step.

testGroup.name: TEST GROUP
testGroup.note: Stored in global_message_threads. Staging reads groups from chat_groups, so the group must also have a chat_groups row before staging specs can see it.

testUser.note: Existing e2e account, already a member of TEST GROUP. Chosen instead of creating a new account.
